_comment: Ruff VPS egg — import via Admin > Nests > (a nest) > Import Egg. Set the server's Environment Type to 'VPS' when creating it. Requires a node running the Dawg daemon with qemu.enabled.
name: VPS (Linux)
author: admin@bytte.cloud
description: A Linux VPS — a QEMU/KVM virtual machine provisioned from a cloud image via cloud-init. The 'Docker image' below is reused by the Dawg daemon as the VM's base disk template (a qcow2 path/filename on the node, or an http(s):// URL to a cloud image). VM provisioning is handled by the daemon, so the installation script is a no-op. Set the server's Environment Type to 'VPS' on creation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# VM provisioning (disk overlay, cloud-init, libvirt domain) is performed by the
# Dawg daemon's QEMU backend (Environment.Create), not by this script. Wings
# skips this container install entirely for VM servers; it exists only so the
# egg is valid.
echo 'VPS provisioning is handled by the daemon.'
exit 0

variables.name: Root Password
variables.description: Initial login password for the VM. Either this or an SSH key is required for the first boot.

variables.name: SSH Public Keys
variables.description: Newline- or comma-separated SSH public keys to authorize for login.

variables.name: Login Username
variables.description: The user account created in the guest (defaults to root).

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: The hostname set inside the guest. Defaults to a name derived from the server UUID.
